pages.text: You improved this focus from the Gemstone Malignasaur's signature attack, but no matter how you put it, its essence is squirting water from a gun - or to put it more formally, a portable high-pressure water cannon.

pages.title: Ocean Breath Focus
pages.text: 24 souls, 1 second of wind-up, 5 second cooldown. Higher spell levels fire more bolts; cast from a Abyss Staff of the same school for one more level. Anything that fears water takes triple drowning damage.
